items.text: GraphicsDeviceManager subscribes a lambda capturing raw this to GameWindow::ClientSizeChanged, discards the removal token and never unsubscribes (Dispose removes only services), so a manager destroyed or replaced while its game window lives leaves a dangling resize callback.
GraphicsDeviceManager::Dispose(bool) raises Disposed before setting disposed_, so a Disposed handler that disposes the manager again re-runs Dispose (and can recurse).
A PreparingDeviceSettings handler that sets the GraphicsDeviceInformation adapter to null causes a null dereference in applyToExistingRenderer (Reset(pp, *adapter)); no argument check exists.
Calling ApplyChanges from a PreparingDeviceSettings handler recurses: prefsChanged_ is cleared only at the end of the pass, so the nested call raises the event again.

GraphicsDevice::Reset rolls back only window application and SetVirtualResolution; an exception from UpdatePresentationFormatEXT, ApplyMultiSampleCount or SetSwapInterval leaves the new presentation parameters stored, render targets unbound and DeviceReset unraised after DeviceResetting.

DIRECTX9 throws std::runtime_error "not yet implemented" from SetContextRecoveryEnabled and SetStringMarkerEXT; GraphicsDevice::SetContextRecoveryEnabled stores the flag before forwarding, so the device flag changes even though the call throws.
GraphicsDevice construction was not transactional (leaked window, input handle or video lease on a later failure) and teardown quit the SDL video subsystem unconditionally.
Device disposal set IsDisposed last, so a Disposing listener could re-enter, and a still-bound RenderTarget2D could throw mid-disposal after the registry was cleared.
items.evidence: modules/graphics/src/Xna/GraphicsDevice.cpp (Dispose sets isDisposed_ first); modules/graphics/src/Xna/RenderTarget2D.cpp (Dispose guard skipped when device disposed); GraphicsDeviceDisposalHookTests.cpp

items.section: Flush timing: sorting without draw-call coalescing
items.text: SpriteSortMode::Immediate on EasyGL and Vulkan still batches below the ISpriteBatchRenderer seam, so a texture rewritten between two Draw calls is rasterised with its final contents for every sprite of the batch (recorded in CNA as VULKAN-057).

SpriteFont/DrawString pixel tests are registered for EasyGL, SDL_RENDERER, VULKAN, SOFTWARE, OPENGL4 and DIRECTX11/12 parity and FREEDIRECT only; the remaining families rely on shared layout code without a text pixel test.
CNA docs/spritefont-support.md is stale (says SpriteEffects has no bitwise operators and the tables have three entries, and that Vulkan is not pixel-verified).
